```artifact
Feature: System Usability and Documentation

  Scenario: Non-technical users can complete a Consultation Request within 5 minutes
    Given a user with no computer background
    When the user initiates a Consultation Request
    And the system presents only minimal and relevant questions
    Then the user completes the request in less than 5 minutes

  Scenario: Navigation is simple and intuitive
    Given a user logged into the system
    When the user navigates to the Consultation Request page
    Then the user reaches the request form in no more than 3 clicks

  Scenario: Consultation Request exceeds the 5‑minute threshold
    Given a user with no computer background
    When the user initiates a Consultation Request
    And the system presents only minimal and relevant questions
    And the user takes longer than 5 minutes to complete the request
    Then an error message is displayed indicating the time limit has been exceeded

  Scenario: Installation Guide is prepared and contains required sections
    Given the installation package is downloaded
    When the installation script is executed
    Then the Installation Guide includes:
      | Section                     |
      | Step-by-step instructions for downloading, extracting, and running the installation script |

  Scenario: User Manual is prepared and contains required instructions
    Given the User Manual document is generated
    When a user accesses the User Manual
    Then the User Manual includes:
      | Section                     |
      | Clear instructions for using the system |

  Scenario Outline: Verify installation process outcome
    Given the installation package is downloaded
    When the installation script is executed
    Then the installation should complete without errors
    Examples:
      | download_status |
      | downloaded       |

  Scenario Outline: Verify error handling during installation
    Given the installation package is downloaded
    When the extraction step fails
    Then an error message is displayed indicating extraction failure
    Examples:
      | download_status |
      | downloaded       |
```
